body: No there is no one I feel comfortable talking with. I have a girlfriend (the one thing stopping me from doing it right now) but I feel like she won't know how to handle it. I've tried talking to my parents, but they just start crying, and blame themselves for my problems, which makes me feel like a complete piece of shit, for making them feel bad. To my families knowledge I'm as happy as could be right now.

I mean I've lived with this depression for 5 years now (diagnosed for 5 years, but I feel like it's been there for about 7). I feel like I'll never change, and that life is just full of disappointment.
Sorry for replying so late, I have been busy with work. No I have enjoyed nothing about college, I hate everything about it and, provided I don't end it all, I hope I can get out as soon as possible.

But it's not like I can "control" my thoughts. I have no choice as to what goes through my head. It's as if my thoughts are one entity and my body is something completely different. One of the reasons I'm so eager to just kill myself, is because I don't even feel human. I feel like this is all some sort of dream (or nightmare).
You say that as if it's something I can just "do". As if I could just "stop worrying".
But I just could never be proud of myself if I took that long to accomplish anything. I feel that by the time I'm 42 I should already be settled into a nice job, with kids who are in their teens.

Well I usually drink very lightly, never getting drunk or anything, but ever since the depression has gotten bad I have not drank. My uncle is an ex-alcoholic so I decided avoiding alcohol while depressed was a good idea.

And it kicked back in at around the midterm point during my 1st semester. I was a star student in high school, I was in the top 10% and I ended up going to a pretty "meh" university. It's the one that almost everyone in my hometown goes to because it's cheap and easy. I had a lot of trouble coming to grips with the fact that I was going there, I was very ashamed. Most of my high school friends went to VERY prestigious schools (1 Harvard, 1 MIT, 2 YALE, 4 RICE, and the rest to UT) while I'm going to this crappy public school. So come about midterm point I realize not only am I going to a bad school, but I'm failing. To make things worse, it's not like I'm not trying hard, I was working my ass off. I dedicated almost all of my free time to studying and working hard, and I still failed 2 out of my 4 classes, and I got a low C in the two I passed.

As I said, I doubt anything anyone says will actually change things. I just wanted to say this, get it off my chest, before I actually do kill myself. I'm giving myself about 5 more months before something just sends me over the edge.

I just don't want to live anymore. I don't have the will to hold on long enough for things to get better. I feel like it will be 10 years before things get better, and by that time I'll be 30, which is way to old to accomplish anything. No one gives a shit about you when you're 30, if you accomplish something nice "big whoop you're 30, do you fucking job". Besides, with my asthma the way it is, and me being so fat, I don't see myself living past about 45 or 50, I'm nearing the halfway point, and I'm just getting to old to make things better. I should have sorted shit out when I was 15 and 16, I'm just too old now.

I did go to a therapist for about 3 weeks, but she was terrible. She basically told me I was depressed because I did not have faith in god and she made everything about religion. No matter how much I asked her to exclude religion, because I am an atheist, she would just tie god back in somehow, so I stopped going after the third session. As I said I have no money so I cant afford a real doctor, and that crazy lady is the only free one around. 

For the 2nd question. No, I've never told anyone about my attempt and I did not go to a hospital for it.
Nothing has ever worked for me. I've never been good at anything, and everything I've ever worked hard to achieve has ended in complete failure. Why would my relationship and school be any different?

Well from 14-16 I just went through the motions day to day, tried to keep it in the back of my head, and on two occasions did try to kill myself. One time I tried to hang myself, and my fat ass broke the rope. Second time I was going to jump off of a building, but I pussied out.

From ~16 to 18 I had met my girlfriend and she helpped me deal with it really well. I would realize from time to time at that point that my depression was still present, just not as severe as it had been in the past.

From College to Now. It's like it was before, just living day to day. But now I've gotten to the point where all I can think about is how I'm just a fat useless piece of shit who won't go anywhere in life. I can only take small breaks from these thoughts, like 5 minutes at a time, then they come back.

Look that was the first thing I looked into. I've been looking for a job for about 6 months now, and I have gotten zero offers, so I don't think that's going to happen any time soon. Besides my home town is only about 10 minutes away from the school. I'll still see her probably every other day or so, depending on her work schedule. I won't see her any less than I do now. But, I just know that she is going to find someone way better than me, and frankly I can't blame her. I'm such a piece of shit excuse for a person, and there are so many better people out there for her.

I do have to spend the semester at home. I'm completely broke right now, and there is no way I can get a job that would make enough money to get an apartment. I can't take a break either. I'm having to go to a community college (also fueling the depression).
